activity.overview: Tap one finger for each sound, then blend the sounds into a word.
activity.passage: Every word is made of sounds. Tap one finger for each sound you hear. Then slide the sounds together to say the word. Listen: /m/ /a/ /t/. Mat! Now it is your turn.

questions.prompt: Tap the sounds: /s/ /i/ /t/. Blend them. Say the word.
Tap the sounds: /b/ /u/ /s/. Blend them. Say the word.
Say the word hen. Tap each sound. How many sounds did you tap?
Say the word fox. What sound do you hear in the middle?

activity.subject: english-language-arts
activity.title: Tap and Blend
